name: CipherSentinel - Enterprise SOC Automation & Live 2s Simulation

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ CIPHERSENTINEL SOC AUTOMATION & LIVE SIMULATION
**Features in this workflow:**
1. **Automated Pipeline**: Authenticates, aggregates multi-table telemetry, validates with Ollama Qwen3, and dispatches incident alerts to `sanskar0912gharal@gmail.com`.
2. **🔴 Live Telemetry Simulator**: Ingests realistic web logs **one-by-one every 2 seconds** into the backend via a 2s Wait loop, updating the live dashboard in real time.

## 🔴 SECTION 2: LIVE SIMULATION (2-SECOND WEB LOG STREAM)
This subflow loops over enterprise web logs and sends them **one by one every 2 seconds** to `POST http://localhost:8000/data/stream-log`.
- Controlled by a **Wait Node (2.0s)**
- Displays immediately in the **Streamlit Dashboard** under *'🔴 Live Simulation (n8n Web Log Stream)'*
- Detects volumetric exfiltration, personal cloud leaks, and DNS tunneling in real time.
